theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : NNReal, ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity A → A.support ⊆ K → A.mass ≤ Λ → A.boundary.mass ≤ Λ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ A - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ ε ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * A.boundary.mass ∧ R.support ⊆ cthickening 1 K
